newsitem.title: CANADA: Caledonia finds Zambian cobalt prospect.
newsitem.headline: Caledonia finds Zambian cobalt prospect.

text.p: Caledonia Mining Corp said on Wednesday that it had made a "significant" cobalt oxide discovery at the Bopalo prospect in Zambia.
The discovery is in the Kadola licence area about 20 km east of Caledonia's Kadola West copper oxide deposit.
A strong cobalt geochemical anomaly measuring 5000 metres by 250 metres was tested with three shallow reverse circulation drill holes, Caledonia said in a statement.
All three holes intersected signficant cobalt mineralization over widths of between 13 and 24 metres, the company said.
